title: Maharashtra MLC polls: Lessons for the BJP, hope for Maha Vikas Aghadi | Explained
description: Congress hits the BJP where it hurts the most. Its only victory is in the RSS HQ and BJP’s traditional stronghold of Nagpur, Sharad Pawar’s party shines with a 100% strike rate; MVA wins all three Graduates’ constituencies; Mahayuti wins both Teachers’ constituencies
